reasons_for_non_applicability: count_budget compares a count and has no denominator, so there is nothing to swap
count_lower_bound compares a count and has no denominator, so there is nothing to swap
exact_count compares a count and has no denominator, so there is nothing to swap
focal_budget compares a count and has no denominator, so there is nothing to swap
capital_char counts raw characters of the answer and count_budget has no word denominator, so no composition order can move either side of the comparison
comma counts raw characters of the answer and count_budget has no word denominator, so no composition order can move either side of the comparison

folding before segmenting splits a word carrying U+0130 into a first piece ending in the folded i and a final piece carrying the original word's ending. A suffix test therefore matches the same words under either order: the extra piece can never end in 'ing', and the piece that does keeps the ending it had. Registered as a non-separable reading and checked against the whole corpus rather than asserted

folding before segmenting splits a word carrying U+0130 into a first piece ending in the folded i and a final piece carrying the original word's ending. A suffix test therefore matches the same words under either order: the extra piece can never end in 's', and the piece that does keeps the ending it had. Registered as a non-separable reading and checked against the whole corpus rather than asserted

folding before segmenting splits a word carrying U+0130 into a first piece ending in the folded i and a final piece carrying the original word's ending. A suffix test therefore matches the same words under either order: the extra piece can never end in 'y', and the piece that does keeps the ending it had. Registered as a non-separable reading and checked against the whole corpus rather than asserted
semicolon counts raw characters of the answer and exact_count has no word denominator, so no composition order can move either side of the comparison
sentence counts raw characters of the answer and count_budget has no word denominator, so no composition order can move either side of the comparison
count_budget is satisfied by an empty answer under the registered reading as well, so no verdict moves. §9.3's non-vacuity flag records that pass separately and is not part of the predicate
focal_budget is satisfied by an empty answer under the registered reading as well, so no verdict moves. §9.3's non-vacuity flag records that pass separately and is not part of the predicate

criterion: every reading the applicability rule calls meaningful is exhibited by a discriminating case somewhere in the frozen suites or the constructed cases, at some declared severity; every reading it calls not meaningful discriminates nowhere, and its reason is recorded
